note: The input controls whether the TGA is treated as indexed, which changes the decoder to load a palette from the stream.
The palette buffer size is derived directly from the header fields before the palette bytes are read.
The loader assumes the palette bytes exist and only checks the bulk read result after attempting to read them, which allows a short input to drive an over-read in the underlying stream access.
The decoder advances into the palette region based on the header before reading any palette entries.
After the truncated palette, the decoder still proceeds to fetch indexed pixel bytes from the stream, which can consume past the end of the provided data when the image payload is also absent.
